{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check data types again, specifically for 'customer_age'
print("Data types:")
print(sales_df.dtypes)

# Check for missing values in 'customer_age'
print("\nMissing values in customer_age:")
print(sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum())"}
